card.summary: No storage quota. Kakao's message API takes an IMAGE URL that you host yourself; it does not accept a binary upload and store it for you.

free_tier.stated: No storage quota. Kakao's message API takes an IMAGE URL that you host yourself; it does not accept a binary upload and store it for you.

egress.terms: N/A. There is no Kakao-hosted media to egress. The direction is the opposite of what this project needs: Kakao asks YOU for a public URL.

record.tooling: kakao-business SDKs / raw REST; channel management APIs. Nothing that stores blobs.
record.chaining: Not chainable. It is a message-delivery API, not an object store. Being a URL consumer rather than a URL producer makes it structurally useless here.
record.limits_note: Image is passed as a URL reference with Kakao's own size/format constraints on the linked asset; no upload endpoint, no media_id, no retention to speak of.
record.reliability_note: No data-vanishing risk because no data is stored. Also no storage. An anti-candidate.

evidence.proved: read live: the channel docs cover friend groups/targeting; media is supplied as an external URL, no upload-and-store endpoint appears anywhere in the API surface
